# rbinmcp - Decommissioned

This repository has been **decommissioned** and split into separate maintainable MCP servers:

- **r2 backend** -> [github.com/kirkderp/rbinr2](https://github.com/kirkderp/rbinr2)
- **Ghidra backend** -> [github.com/kirkderp/rbinghidra](https://github.com/kirkderp/rbinghidra)
- **ILSpy (.NET) backend** -> [github.com/kirkderp/rbinilspy](https://github.com/kirkderp/rbinilspy)

All code and crates have been removed to avoid confusion. Use the individual repos above for binary analysis MCP tooling.
